title: PR 4e — employee and pay-frequency chat skills (query, confirm-before-write edit, draft pay runs) with sensitive-id refusal

goals.text: query-employee / update-employee / generate-pay-run-drafts route deterministically (order-independent, no collision with payroll-status, run-payroll, record-expense, set-vendor-alias or budgets); replies show the market label (Fortnightly AU, Bi-weekly US/CA) in en/fr-CA/zh-CN and money in the tenant currency+locale; update-employee is confirmBefore (plan card, nothing executed before confirm), PUTs employees/[id] with only payFrequency or payRateCents (same zod validation + audit), and says it applies from the next draft; drafts go through POST pay-runs {generate:'drafts'}; chat/web label maps are pinned together; MCP reaches the same skills through ask_agentbook -> agent brain.

Chat never reads AbEmployeeSensitive and refuses tax id / bank / super edits with a pointer to the profile screen, echoing no value; a message with a checksum-valid personal TFN/SIN/SSN (labelled, or unlabelled without a business prefix) is refused before classification (invoice/ABN/ACN/EIN/bank/routing numbers pass), Telegram refuses before its own context/thread/memory writes, the shared turn writers redact,, the LLM, sessions or memory, the AbConversation row holds only the redacted text, and nothing logged contains the digits.

launch.rollback: Revert the PR. No schema change. The three skills disappear from BUILT_IN_SKILLS (code wins over AbSkillManifest rows, so stale rows are inert); payroll-status/run-payroll/record-expense/set-vendor-alias routing returns to its previous patterns; the sensitive-id pre-check is removed. Employee edits made via chat meanwhile are ordinary PUT employees/[id] writes with AbEmployeeChange audit rows and stay valid; draft pay runs created via chat are ordinary drafts (DELETE pay-runs/[id] removes them).
